# Simply Hosting & Servers outage history — every incident their status page has posted

**7 Simply Hosting & Servers incidents on record** spanning **2025-10-02** to **2026-07-10**. Status page:
[https://status.simplyhosting.com](https://status.simplyhosting.com) · platform:
`statuspage` · last polled **2026-09-09 12:30 UTC**, last observed
state **`maintenance`**.

Only **6** Simply Hosting & Servers incidents carry both a vendor-posted start and resolve time — below the 20-incident floor this dataset requires before publishing a median, so none is quoted here.

This page republishes what Simply Hosting & Servers posted on its own status page. It is rebuilt
daily by an automated poller — no login, no account, MIT-licensed data.

## What is counted, and what is not

Of 7 recorded incidents, **6** have a usable length. Excluded:
1 maintenance, 0 still open or missing a timestamp, 0 whose resolution time we inferred rather than read, 0 with a resolve time before the start time. Those exclusions are the reason the numbers here are lower than a naive
count of the status page, and they are why a median from this dataset can be
compared across vendors at all.

"Incidents on record" means incidents this poller has seen or backfilled since
**2026-09-04** — it is not a claim about Simply Hosting & Servers's
entire operating history.
